newsitem.title: UK: Brent cargo kept from chain by Glencore - traders.
newsitem.headline: Brent cargo kept from chain by Glencore - traders.

text.p: A cargo of Brent crude oil which had its loading dates brought forward, was passed through the paper chains on Monday and kept before the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargo was originally due to load in the March 23-25 range but was brought forward and will now load in the March 18-20 range. The cargo was kept by Swiss-based trader Glencore, traders said.
Glencore was earlier seen fixing two ULCC's, one confirmed and one on subjects, to lift Brent crude oil from Sullom Voe to the U.S. Gulf and South Africa.
